claim_boundary: High-coverage, effort-bounded evidence map; not a systematic census, exhaustive or comprehensive recall, proof of method adherence, or literal saturation.

excluded: email addresses and web routes embedded in author strings
search queries, logs, and screening implementation
internal campaign IDs and detailed review-status fields
signed, authenticated, session-bearing, and transient URLs
projection.landing_url_policy: Prefer DOI, then OpenAlex, then a non-sensitive HTTPS stable public URL. Publish null when none is available; never publish raw reader fallbacks.
projection.public_id_policy: Release-local sequential ECS-R12 identifier assigned after a deterministic bibliographic sort whose final tie-break is derived only from public fields; internal campaign IDs, mappings, and source order are not published.
